h868v2: Help eight six eight just got a lot smarter. Your branch, on WhatsApp, any hour of the day.
One tap on the green button, and the chat opens. No app to download, and no forms to fill.
We say hello, and show a menu. Your client taps what they need. A question, a claim, an update, a payment, or a quote.
Every question after that is a tap too. Is it urgent? Yes or no, one tap. Nobody types a number, and nothing is asked twice.
We only ask for their name, and a policy number if they have one. Never bank details, never I D numbers.
Then it lands on Query Pal, our query system, with a reference, and goes to the right department.
Your client gets a receipt card right in WhatsApp, with the reference and the target time. The same confirmation arrives by email.
Our support team sees the whole chat, with the details already filled in. Query Pal now has a pal to work with.
When it's resolved, we close it with a summary, and ask for a star rating, right there in the chat. A low rating gets a call back.
And if a query is still open, we don't go quiet. A friendly update comes every three working days, until it's done.
Agents, share the link with your clients. We've just welcomed our first client, and the insights are coming soon.
Help eight six eight. Always on, and always us. Tap the green button on our website, and say hello.
